Weakest moment: the user's turn-1 reply already carried an explicit stop ('plan signed off, not re-litigating... Done re-walking details'), and the examiner answered with 'Straight to stress-test' and ran a full probe anyway — it never offered the decline/redirect the case calls for (record as-is, or probe one named aspect), and only halted after the stop was repeated verbatim. The declared 'aporia' verdict also over-labels: nothing reached impasse under questioning; the ticket-sufficiency gap is simply ground never entered because the user closed the session, which is closer to accepted-as-is with an open question — though the brief body is commendably candid that only one question was asked and no contradiction was checked for.
